raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions casts both as if they were the same. v2 rows from the Chicago evening land in 00:00-06:00 UTC on the next date. That explains the 41-row 2026-01-19 and the early-morning timestamps on 2026-01-18. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January, no DST) fixes txn_ts and txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
